standard.summary: 训练过程中定期生成预览图像，让你实时观察训练效果。可以设置每 N 步或每 N 个 epoch 生成一次。
standard.effect: sample_every=100 表示每 100 步生成一次预览。sample_prompts 指定用于生成的 prompt 列表。预览不影响训练过程。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练时观察收敛进度。调参时快速验证配置是否合理。
standard.avoidWhen: 预览生成需要时间（每批约 5-30 秒），频繁采样会拖慢训练。preview_device='off' 完全禁用。

standard_en.summary: Generates preview images periodically during training so you can watch the effect in real time. You can have one generated every N steps or every N epochs.
standard_en.effect: sample_every=100 means a preview every 100 steps. sample_prompts names the prompt list used for generation. Previews do not affect the training process.
standard_en.whenToUse: To watch convergence on a long run. To check quickly whether a configuration is sensible while tuning.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Generating a preview takes time (roughly 5-30 seconds per batch), so frequent sampling slows training down. preview_device='off' disables it entirely.

advanced.principle: 在指定的训练步暂停训练循环，用当前的 LoRA 权重 + 底模做一次推理。sample_sampler 控制采样器（euler_a 最常用），sample_steps 控制去噪步数，sample_cfg 控制 classifier-free guidance 强度。ephemeral_preview_pipeline 在生成后立即释放推理 pipeline 显存。
advanced.intervention: training_loop 在 step % sample_every == 0 时插入采样代码。
advanced.expectedImpact: 不影响训练质量。生成耗时取决于分辨率和步数。
advanced.tradeoffs: preview_device='gpu' 在 GPU 上生成最快但占用训练显存；'cpu' 慢但不占 GPU；'off' 禁用。micro_vae_preview 使用小型 VAE 加速解码。

advanced_en.principle: Pauses the training loop at the specified step and runs one inference with the current LoRA weights + base model. sample_sampler controls the sampler (euler_a is most common), sample_steps the denoising steps, sample_cfg the classifier-free guidance strength. ephemeral_preview_pipeline releases the inference pipeline's VRAM immediately after generation.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop inserts the sampling code when step % sample_every == 0.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Does not affect training quality. Generation time depends on resolution and step count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: preview_device='gpu' is fastest but occupies training VRAM; 'cpu' is slow but uses no GPU; 'off' disables. micro_vae_preview uses a small VAE to speed up decoding.
